title: AlignBench: Benchmarking Chinese Alignment of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: This benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a general-purpose benchmark for evaluating the alignment of Large Language Models in Chinese across eight categories: Fundamental Language Ability, Advanced Chinese Understanding, Open-ended Questions, Writing Ability, Logical Reasoning, Mathematics, Task-oriented Role Play, and Professional Knowledge.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
